title: Stage III cancer to 200+ startups: How Tej Chingtham built the Northeast’s first incubator
summary: From a push for better startup support to mentoring 200+ ventures, Prof. (Dr.) Tej Chingtham is helping shape Northeast India’s startup ecosystem through AIC-SMUTBI.
llm_summary: Prof. (Dr.) Tej Chingmung Chingtham turned his own battle with stage‑III cancer into a catalyst for entrepreneurship, founding AIC‑SMUTBI—the first dedicated startup incubator in Northeast India. By creating a robust support network and hands‑on mentorship, he has helped launch and scale more than 200 early‑stage ventures, positioning the region as an emerging hub for tech innovation.
